evidence: MECHANICS (all four clauses hold, verified by reading and by executing the frozen score.py). (1) Gates are 0.0 and carry no mass: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-3 '[gates] render = 0.0 constraints = 0.0'; [weights] (lines 5-8) list only functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2; score.py:46 'weighted = sum(w * scores[k] for k, w in weights.items()) / sum(weights.values())' sums weights only, so gates cannot add reward. Neither gate judge.toml has a [judge] weight; each gate has one binary criterion with aggregation='all_pass' (render/judge.toml:14-21, constraints/judge.toml:14-21). scoring.toml, test.sh and score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (sha256 scoring.toml 95f70d6e... in both), so shared policy is untouched. (2) Gate failure zeroes the reward and skips scored: test.sh:60 write_zero_reward first and trap ensure_reward; test.sh:212 'rm -rf "$LOG_DIR/scored"' removes stale scored output before gates; test.sh:213-215 a gates rewardkit failure/timeout exits with the zero record; score.py:41 'gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor ...)', :42 scored_ran requires gates_passed, :48 reward is 0.0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed, :83 returns 1 on gate failure; test.sh:218-222 'case ... 1) exit 0 ;; *) write_zero_reward; exit 0' so run_suite scored (test.sh:224) is never reached. (3) Functional floor: scoring.toml:10-11 '[floors] functional = 0.05', score.py:47 strict '>' comparison. (4) Executed probe: evidence/43/score_policy_probe.py copies the frozen score.py+scoring.toml into a temp dir and feeds synthetic RewardKit outputs (Python 3.12.10); output in evidence/43/score_policy_probe.out.txt: gates pass + perfect scored -> 1.0; render=0 with perfect scored present -> reward 0.0, exit 1; constraints=0 -> 0.0, exit 1; gates pass but scored missing (timeout) -> 0.0; functional exactly 0.05 with polish/visual 1.0 -> reward 0.0 although weighted_score 0.43 (floor blocks farming); functional 0 with polish/visual 1.0 -> 0.0 (weighted 0.4 blocked); missing gate key -> exit 2 (test.sh writes plain zero). GATES EXCLUDE DEAD APPS: constraints gate (constraints/judge.toml:23) requires a UI-created job and candidate read back by the Observer in a new independent empty browser context, and explicitly rejects 'a static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app'; render gate (render/judge.toml:23) rejects 'A static picture or only a health response'. Broken-app attempt: a localStorage-only or static-mock app fails the independent-context readback -> 0. A server-memory app passes gates but is then scored, which is correct (restart criterion is in scored). 'CHEAP GATES EARN LITTLE': functional total weight 58.5 over 43 criteria; floor needs >2.925 weight. The gate-overlapping criteria hro_job_open (0.5) + hro_add_candidate (0.5) = 1.0/58.5 = 0.017; with hro_add_email_rules (1.0) = 0.034, still below floor. functional/prompt.md:13 requires every refusal row to have its own observed positive control, so a gate-only app cannot farm move/observer/manager refusal rows (mgr_other_job, observer_readonly, candidate_no_staff, anonymous). The main route over the floor for a gate-only app is hro_restart (1.5) -> ~0.06, which would unlock visual (max 0.2); visual prompt then reviews Board stages, card details, Conversations, Activity and candidate view, which a gate-only app lacks, so likert scores should be low. This is plausible but UNMEASURED.
counterexample: No counterexample defeats this row's mechanics. Residual risks recorded (not row-43 failures): (a) Missing runtime evidence: raw-evidence-index.json scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', so no full verifier run has shown a real gate-failing submission skip the scored suite, nor measured what a gate-only/CRUD-only app earns (estimated functional ~0.03-0.11 -> reward could reach ~0.04+0.2*visual if hro_restart and visual pass); my probe exercises score.py only, not rewardkit/test.sh end to end. (b) Cross-row concern for rows 27/29 (gate content, not gate mechanics): render gate requires 'An incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out with a visible refusal' (render/judge.toml:23), but neither instruction.md nor hireops_rules.md states a visible wrong-password message (only 'Everyone signs in with ... password' and the 401 rule). A conforming app that silently stays on the sign-in form after a bad password would fail the render gate and get reward 0. Low likelihood, total-zero consequence; the owner should have rows 27/29 adjudicate it or relax the gate to 'stays signed out' only.
suggested_fix: No change needed for row 43. Before clearance, add a measured full-verifier run with a gate-failing mutant (e.g., browser-only save) showing scored/ is never created and reward.json reward=0 gates_passed=0, plus a gate-only CRUD mutant measuring functional against the 0.05 floor. Separately consider removing the 'visible refusal' demand from the render gate unless the brief states it.
run_verdict: PARTIAL — score.py policy behaviour CONFIRMED by local execution on synthetic gate/scored inputs (evidence/43/score_policy_probe.out.txt); end-to-end test.sh/rewardkit gate-skip and floor discrimination on real weak apps NOT EXERCISED
